lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: What's the number of your car?

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: When did you bring it to us?

lines.speaker: Mr. Wood
lines.en: I brought it here three days ago.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.zh: 啊，是的，我现在记起来了。

lines.speaker: Mr. Wood
lines.zh: 你们的机械师修好了吗？

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: No, they're still working on it.

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Let's go into the garage and have a look at it.
lines.zh: 我们到车库去看一下吧。

lines.speaker: Mr. Wood
lines.en: I drove it into a lamp-post.
lines.zh: 我把汽车撞在电线杆上了。

lines.speaker: Mr. Wood
lines.zh: 你们的机械师能修好吗？

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: Well, they're trying to repair it, sir.
lines.zh: 啊，他们正设法修呢，先生。

lines.speaker: Attendant
lines.en: But to tell you the truth, you need a new car!
lines.zh: 不过说实在的，您需要一辆新车了！
